content: # History of McKinsey & Company. ## Uploaded by. AI-enhanced title and description. McKinsey & Company was founded in 1926 by James O. McKinsey as an accounting and management consulting firm. It grew quickly in its early years and established offices in major US cities. In the 1930s and 1940s, the firm split and reorganized ownership and leadership multiple times. By the 1950s and 1960s, McKinsey expanded significantly in the US and internationally. The firm established industry specialties and knowledge management practices in the 1970s and 1980s to adapt to increasing competition. McKinsey continued expanding globally in the 1990s and 2000s while also establishing new practices focused on technology, manufacturing, and the public sector. ### Read this document in other languages. ## Share this document. ## Footer menu. ## Support. ## Legal. ## Social. ## Get our free apps. title: James O. McKinsey - Leadership - Harvard Business School
content: * Great American Business Leaders of the 20th Century. McKinsey founded the largest management consulting firm in the world. His greatest contribution was focusing attention on budgeting as a major instrument of management. He asserted the need for continued education for future executives and foresaw the era of the “scientific man” in business; an era characterized by careful planning and research. #### Personal. #### Education / Military. * **Graduate:** University of Oklahoma, University of Chicago. * **Undergraduate:** Missouri State Teachers College. Initiatives focus on societal challenges that are too complex for any one discipline or industry to solve alone.
